items.tab_content: A Reader seat costs EUR 12 per month for one person. Practitioner, at EUR 29, adds citation exports and the monthly methods briefing. Institutions get 250 concurrent seats for EUR 6,400 a year.
Everything is published under CC BY-NC 4.0. Non-commercial use only needs attribution. For commercial use, the rights desk sends a quote, usually within five working days.
Issue 2026/2 added 312 papers and opened 289 older ones to all readers. Saved searches run again overnight and email you any changes.
